newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Central unit prices new debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Central unit prices new debt issue.

text.p: Illinois Central Corp said on Friday its Illinois Central Railroad Co unit is privately placing $125 million in 100-year debentures, due September 15, 2096.
The coupon rate is 7.70 percent and the yield is 7.73 percent, the company said.

The rail division said it will use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including paying off commercial paper as it matures and funding the cost of any settlement it may reach with one of its unions. The company may also use some of the money raised to cover expenses related to a bulk commodities terminal being built in Louisiana.
Illinois Central is a rail holding company.
Its stock was down 1/4 Friday morning at 31-1/4.
